title: ui
intro:
Top level user interface.
   Used by Toplevel @ ui (see 107.30, page 626) .

sections.name: none
sections.desc:
No user unterface.
   This is useful when running from a batch program, or as a component in a larger
system.

sections.name: progress
sections.desc:
Write progress on standard output (or standard error).
   This is useful when starting the program from a text terminal, or from inside
another program such as an editor that can capture the output.
